messages:
Sam (AM): FYI BetaHealth POC stalled on observability handoff. Logs arrive but they don't join to traces; Splunk drain intermittently 403/429.
Rina (SE): Paste a raw log line + example trace id so I can inspect. Is trace in header or body?
Sam (AM): Log: 2026-03-19T14:05:11Z lvl=info msg="resp sent" route=/v1/chat trace=abcd1234 user=beta-42
Trace in body as "trace". Their APM expects X-BH-TRACE header.
Rina (SE): Our collector forwards x-request-id/traceparent/b3. Edge strips unknown headers by default. @Luca can we enable per-tenant header passthrough or copy trace->X-BH-TRACE?
Luca (SRE): Yes  we have a tenant flag to whitelist custom headers. I can enable and add a mapping to inject X-BH-TRACE from the log-field. Will roll in ~10m. Also our drain rate is capped at 15/s; I can bump to 60/s for 24h for POC testing.
logs-bot: Drain job 4712 -> FAILED (403) to https://ingest.beta.splunk:8088 (attempt 2)
reason: auth header rewritten by customer edge
Maya (Eng): Our drain sends Authorization: Splunk <token>. If their proxy rewrites Authorization, they can accept X-Splunk-Token instead. We can switch to that header per-tenant as a workaround.
Sam (AM): Beta confirmed they can accept X-Splunk-Token and can map X-BH-TRACE to spans on their side, but asked us to inject X-BH-TRACE to be safe.
Luca (SRE): Done  tenant whitelist + header mapping live; rate bumped to 60/s for 24h. Monitoring logs and export successes.
logs-bot: Drain job 4713 -> SUCCESS to datadog-forwarder (latency 150ms)
Rina (SE): Sending curl examples to Beta and #sales:
curl -v -H "Authorization: Splunk <their-token>" -H "X-Request-ID: 999" https://ingest.beta.splunk:8088/services/collector/event/1.0
or
curl -v -H "X-Splunk-Token: <their-token>" -H "X-Request-ID: 999" https://ingest.beta.splunk:8088/services/collector/event/1.0
Sam (AM): Security Q: can Beta use their KMS for logs in Private?
Maya (Eng): Yes for Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS/HSM. For Hosted we offer BYOK options on sensitive fields. I'll paste SOC2/KMS wording into the questionnaire.
Sam (AM): Next steps: Luca monitor for 24h; Maya update questionnaire + enable temporary retention; Rina post curl examples; Sam to run validation call 2026-03-19 19:00 UTC. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
